text:
Aisha: Quick design review — the rules editor reorder is confusing on long lists. Dragging sometimes jumps and preview keeps re-running. Screenshot + short vid attached. Tom: Repro'd. Drag item at index 10 toward top and it snaps past the intended slot. Looks like snap slab + virtualization mismatch. Ravi: Two requests: (1) pause the Preview while a reorder gesture is active, show overlay 'Preview paused while editing'; (2) debounce the server save (100-200ms) so we don't spam sim runs. Ivy: Accessibility: keyboard moves don't announce a new position. Current SR says 'Saved' only. We should announce 'Moved rule "Block-Auth" to position 3 of 12' and add Move Up / Move Down visible controls on focus. Also increase drag handle hit target to 44px and ensure a focus-visible outline. a11y-bot: Scan: drag-handle contrast 2.5:1 (fail). Interactive target 16px (fail). Recommend hit target >=44px, role="button", aria-label on handle, and an aria-live region for position changes. Tom: UX microinteraction: lower snap threshold and add a 120ms settle before committing order to server. Also soften movement with a 120ms fade/translate to avoid teleporting. Aisha: Copy nudge for failures: instead of 'Invalid rule precedence' use 'Order not applied — check for locked rules or circular dependencies.' Toast short: 'Order not saved — resolve dependencies.' Ravi: Backend note: sim may return 202 then 200 while warming. Frontend currently treats non-200 as error — handle 202 as processing and show spinner next to Preview title. Ivy: I'll add the aria-live snippet to the component library:
Moved rule "Block-Auth" to position 3 of 12
. Also drafting keyboard guidance and hotkeys (Alt+Shift+Up/Down). Aisha: Great. Next steps: @Tom mock fade + lower snap; @Ravi debounce/save changes and treat 202 as in-progress; @Ivy add SR announcement + keyboard affordances; I'll prioritize handle hit target + focus ring. Sync Thu 10am PT if needed. Thanks!
